signals_info.description: Whether the associated intersection conflict area is occupied; 0 means unoccupied.

nl_Literal_translation_en: At the current time or at some future time, the intersection conflict area shall be unoccupied.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 在当前或未来某个时刻，路口冲突区域应处于未被占用状态。
nl_Paraphrase_en: The intersection conflict area shall be clear now or at some later time.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: 路口冲突区域应在当前或之后某个时刻处于无占用状态。
